market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76.3k needs to fall ~48% to hit $40k. The 2026 YTD low is ~$63k. While analysts identify $43k as a deep capitulation level, hitting $40k by year-end requires a severe bear market. Possible but a tail outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of severe macro shock or crypto-specific contagion event
